requirements.requirement: Configure a local caching DNS resolver on node1 and make system applications use it.
requirements.summary: dnsmasq was configured with a 1,000-entry cache, enabled, and observed listening on TCP/UDP 127.0.0.1:53. NetworkManager and /etc/resolv.conf selected 127.0.0.1, while dnsmasq statistics directly showed forwarded and locally answered queries. The same service, listener, resolver selection, and cache activity recovered after restart.

requirements.requirement: Preserve normal external name resolution for applications on node1.
requirements.summary: Multiple external names resolved through the system resolver after switching it to 127.0.0.1. Resolution also succeeded after restart, and dnsmasq reported forwarding to 10.100.240.1 without retries or failures.

overall_summary: Both material task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol was also coherently demonstrated: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, restart scheduling was acknowledged, the post-restart boot ID differed, and service, configuration, external resolution, and cache behavior recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: Package-manager consistency checks timed out both before and after execution, so package database health was not independently verified.

Lifecycle temporary-file inventories covered /tmp but not /var/tmp, so final retention of the installation tracking files is inferred from the absence of captured cleanup rather than directly observed in the final snapshot.

operational_hygiene.summary: The package installation, resolver configuration, NetworkManager update/reapply, service enablement, cache probes, and restart all had clear task or evidence-protocol roles. The only unnecessary retained-state concern was the installation log and completion sentinel created under /var/tmp by cmd-d0c7e32179c643d7; cmd-62cd2b73d1634352 confirms they existed, and no later command reverted them. Their final retention was not directly inventoried. No failed services or externally exposed DNS listener was observed after completion.
